Russian Missile Disappears From Radar Near Polish Town as Air Raid Sirens Sound A Russian cruise missile may have entered Polish airspace during a massive missile attack on Ukraine on November 20. The Ukrainian air threat monitoring group eRadar reported that Russian cruise missiles were initially detected over Ukraine’s western Lviv region before one was reportedly tracked near the Polish town of Cieszanów, in the Podkarpackie region. According to the monitoring group, the missile subsequently disappeared from radar near the town. However, Polish authorities have not officially confirmed that any Russian missile crossed the border during the attack. Separately, CCTV footage purportedly captured an explosion near the Polish village of Chmielek, approximately 46 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.
